name: The Protectors
description:
The Protectors is a British television series, an action thriller created by Gerry Anderson. It was Anderson's second TV series using live actors as opposed to electronic marionettes, and also his second to be firmly set in contemporary times. It was also the only Gerry Anderson produced television series that was not of the fantasy or science fiction genres. It was produced by Lew Grade's ITC Entertainment production company. Despite not featuring marionettes or any real science fiction elements, The Protectors became one of Anderson's most popular productions, easily winning a renewal for a second season. A third season was in the planning stages when the show's major sponsor pulled out, forcing its cancellation.

The Protectors first aired in 1972 and 1973, and ran to 52 episodes over two series, each 25 minutes long - making it one of the last series of this type to be produced in a half-hour format. It starred Robert Vaughn as Harry Rule, Nyree Dawn Porter as the Contessa Caroline di Contini, and Tony Anholt as Paul Buchet. Episodes often featured prominent guest actors.

videos.title: 2,000 ft to Die
videos.overview: A friend of Harry's insists on doing a dangerous skydiving trick despite the fact that gold smugglers are trying to kill him.

videos.title: Brother Hood
videos.overview: A wealthy recluse hires the Protectors to break his brother out of prison.

videos.title: See No Evil
videos.overview: While in Rome the Protectors try to help a senator who is being blackmailed.

videos.title: Disappearing Trick
videos.overview: The Contessa ends up putting her life in danger when she agrees to help an old friend win a wager by making him disappear.

videos.title: Ceremony For the Dead
videos.overview: The wife of a president hires the Protectors to guard her critically ill husband whom she fears may be kidnapped.

videos.title: It Was All Over in Leipzig
videos.overview: While investigating a plot to overthrow the government of a Mediterranean nation the Protectors end up confronting two old friends of the Contessa, one with whom she was romantically involved.

videos.title: The Quick Brown Fox
videos.overview: The West German government hires the Protectors to put a pension fund that is supporting fugitive Nazi's out of business.

videos.title: King Con
videos.overview: The Protectors devise an elaborate con to recover a priceless antique which a woman had been conned out of.

videos.title: Thinkback
videos.overview: Harry and the Contessa are the victims of a car crash that was engineered to get information out of them.

videos.title: A Kind of Wild Justice
videos.overview: The daughter of a gangster whom Harry helped put in prison fails twice in her efforts to kill Harry.

videos.title: Balance of Terror
videos.overview: The KGB hires the Protectors to capture a renegade Russian scientist who plans on destroying London with a new virus to show the world how dangerous biological warfare can be.

videos.title: Triple Cross
videos.overview: A kidnapped Paul will be blown to bits unless Harry and the Contessa help steal jewels which they have been hired to safeguard.

videos.title: The Numbers Game
videos.overview: The Protectors only hope of putting a drug smuggling ring out of business lies in being able to decode a coded letter.

videos.title: For the Rest of Your Natural ...
videos.overview: The Contessa is captured by a psychotic killer who puts her on trial for her life.

videos.title: The Bodyguards
videos.overview: The police hire the Protectors to guard the corpse of a bank robber as part of a ruse to capture his accomplices.

videos.title: A Matter of Life and Death
videos.overview: In Malta, with only the body of a dead hippie as a clue, the Protectors go after smugglers despite having no idea what it is that is being smuggled.

videos.title: The Big Hit
videos.overview: After unsuccessful attempts on their lives, Paul and the Contessa are too late to warn Harry that someone is out to kill him.

videos.title: One and One Makes One
videos.overview: The Protectors are hired to track down Bennett, a missing Canadian agent who holds valuable information about a new American-Canadian sky project.

videos.title: Talkdown
videos.overview: Harry must land a small plane on his own when the pilot dies.

videos.title: Vocal
videos.overview: Drug dealers plan on using someone who can impersonate Harry's voice in order to get information out of a blinded Paul.

videos.title: With A Little Help From My Friends
videos.overview: Harry finds his family being threatened after he agrees to guard a visiting president in London.

videos.title: Chase
videos.overview: The Contessa gives Harry a shotgun for his birthday which he soon puts to good use when while investigating political blackmail he becomes the quarry in a manhunt.

videos.title: Your Witness
videos.overview: An important witness to a murder who doesn't want the Protectors protection, vanishes soon after she is placed in the Protectors charge.

videos.title: It Could Be Practically Anywhere on the Island
videos.overview: A small fluffy dog called Muffin is kidnapped from a hotel  to place a microfilm in its collar. The dog is due to be ttansaported to NY. Harry saves the day.

videos.title: The First Circle
videos.overview: Harry is hired to protect a disturbed Vietnam war veteran.

videos.title: A Case For the Right
videos.overview: The Protectors end up in trouble in the Roman tombs.

videos.title: Quin
videos.overview: Harry travels to Spain in order to track down a bounty hunter named Quin.

videos.title: Bagman
videos.overview: The Protectors are called to deliver the ransom for the kidnapped daughter of a Danish aristocrat.

videos.title: Fighting Fund
videos.overview: A revolutionary group steals and auctions off a priceless art collection in order to purchase dynamite to fund their cause.

videos.title: The Last Frontier
videos.overview: The Protectors are hired to smuggle into Britain a Russian scientist who wishes to marry her childhood sweetheart.

videos.title: Baubles, Bangles and Beads
videos.overview: In Denmark, a young woman and her father call on the Protectors to deliver a huge ransom for a stolen jewelry shipment.

videos.title: Petard
videos.overview: The Protectors go after industrial spies who are threatening to topple a chemical company by scooping their best products.

videos.title: Goodbye George
videos.overview: Alone in Italy, the Contessa goes to Venice to find out why the son of a wealthy Brit is making huge withdrawals from his account.

videos.title: Wam (1)
videos.overview: In Salzburg, the Protectors must rescue a group of vacationers whom are unknowingly being held hostage on top of an Austrian mountain.

videos.title: Wam (2)
videos.overview: In Salzburg, the Protectors must rescue a group of vacationers whom are unknowingly being held hostage on top of an Austrian mountain.

videos.title: Implicado
videos.overview: In Spain, an English boy is framed and arrested on drug charges after a drug dealer plants some hash in his backpack.

videos.title: Dragon Chase
videos.overview: In Britain, Harry is called on to protect a Russian author from publishing his anti-socialist book.

videos.title: Decoy
videos.overview: An old friend who has a new lead on an insurance scam calls Harry and the Contessa to Venice, but he is murdered just before they arrive.

videos.title: Border Line
videos.overview: The Protectors are hired by a Hungarian actress wanting to bury her now deceased revolutionary father in their homeland.

videos.title: Zeke's Blues
videos.overview: Harry's college friend Zeke, a pianist, is blackmailed into setting Harry up by mobsters.

videos.title: Lena
videos.overview: In Venice, Harry aids Lena, a journalist, expose a corrupt politician.

videos.title: The Bridge
videos.overview: Undercover as an explosives expert, Harry seeks to rescue a kidnapped girl and prevent a bridge bombing.

videos.title: Sugar and Spice
videos.overview: In order to protect the daughter of a rich industrialist who has received threats against her life, Harry poses as her tutor.

videos.title: Burning Bush
videos.overview: Harry masquerades as a drunk in order to get a Canadian heiress out of a cult.

videos.title: The Tiger and the Goat
videos.overview: The Contessa is used to lure her former lover, a British spy, out into the open.

videos.title: Route 27
videos.overview: Knowing where a huge stash of heroin is hidden, Harry confronts the drug dealers.

videos.title: Trial
videos.overview: The Protectors are called upon when the father of a man on trial for murdering a policeman goes after the judge.

videos.title: Shadbolt
videos.overview: Harry is stalked on a train by Shadbolt, a professional assassin.

videos.title: A Pocketful of Posies
videos.overview: Harry Rule is called upon to see if Eartha Kitt's (guest star)home is haunted.

videos.title: Wheels
videos.overview: The Protectors are hired to discretely research stolen secret Swiss bank account information.

videos.title: The Insider
videos.overview: The Protectors aid a movie director in the retrieval of film  being held for ransom.

videos.title: Blockbuster
videos.overview: The Protectors chase after a stolen platinum shipment.
